title: Tier-3 Encounter-Grammar — encounters bundle payload (DRAFT)
$comment: ARTIFACT B of W1, Tier-3 Encounter-Geometry Run. This is a JSON SCHEMA DATA ARTIFACT, NOT pipeline code — no star-lord emitter wiring. It freezes the payload shape for the reserved top-level `encounters` key of the One-Realm bundle (T3-V7: KR Lane-1 reserved the key and builds no encounter emission until this schema freezes). Companion spec: agentic_orchestration/gandalf/notes/2026-07-22-tier3-w1-encounter-grammar-spec.md. WORKING-LABEL CAVEAT: every `family` value in every instance is a WORKING LABEL, NOT canon (charter §5, T3-V2). Matt's names-review is a pending commitment-boundary. `family` is a string token precisely so a future canon-rename is a value-swap, never a structure change. Congruent with on-disk one_realm_demo_bundle.json (verified 2026-07-22): sibling to top-level keys bundle_version/season_id/kits/monsters/gear_pool/factions/floor_manifest.

season_id.description: Joins the parent bundle's season_id (e.g. cycle-14-wave-5-season-001).

schema_status.description: DRAFT at W1 (freezes shape); LOCKED once Matt's names-review + Gate ratification land.

working_label_caveat.description: Machine-visible restatement of the working-label caveat. All `family` values are provisional; Matt names-review pending.
working_label_caveat.default: All family names in this payload are WORKING LABELS, not canon (charter §5, T3-V2). Rename is value-swap-safe.

provenance_axis.description: The census two-value provenance axis, declared. GENRE-ATTESTED = cited from a shipped genre game; RDR-NATIVE-DERIVED = derived from a family kit-leader's mechanism verbs (R-b2) where the genre has no monster-side attestation. TAG, never row-identity (census §c).

era_decks.description: MACRO tier: one deck per era. 4 entries required (Ages I-IV). Each deck deals map-area archetypes era-personality-honest, with a disposition dimension and a reserved traveling-kin slot.

formation_catalogue.description: MESO tier: formations, ≥2 per family-present (family,era) cell. Sourced from harvest Formation columns (GENRE-ATTESTED) or kit-leader mechanism (RDR-NATIVE-DERIVED).

pressure_verbs.description: MICRO tier: ≥1 pressure-verb set per family. Verbs INHERIT from the family kit-leader mechanism (R-b2).

derived_templates.description: The 5 RDR-NATIVE-DERIVED template entries (Gate-2 hard obligation L-9): SHAPESHIFT-I · SHAPESHIFT-III · DASH-STRIKER-I · CHAIN-BOUNCE-IV · WHIRLWIND-II. Each answers a finding (f-1..f-4) and carries the T3-V2 × L-9 tier-restriction as data (serving_role). f-5 DASH-STRIKER-IV is EXCLUDED (fresh-draft non-obligation). Exactly 5 at W1.

unmapped_reserved.description: Expressible slot for UNMAPPED rows (census §d, U-1..U-7) + the cross-era resurrection-leader candidate verb. Nothing lost, nothing force-mapped. Rides the artifact as findings for the next lap.

encounter_instances.description: OPTIONAL at W1 (empty is valid — W1 freezes the shape). RD-1 (conditional, on W3 gate PASS) populates this: the first act-structured run-object. Item schema is COMPLETE now so RD-1's fill is a validation target, not a schema extension (charter §4, T3-V6). Schema-valid instantiation is RD-1's own done-predicate.

Era.description: Age spine: I=D2(2000) · II=PoE1(2013) · III=GD(2016) · IV=PoE2+LE(2024). Eras = shelves (Q38).

Family.$comment: WORKING LABEL — not canon. Enum lists the 13 current working labels for validation convenience; a future canon-rename swaps values, not structure.

FamilyTier.description: Appendix-B membership tier, so the T3-V2 tier law is re-derivable from data.

ServingRole.description: The T3-V2 × L-9 composition as data. headline_capable = RATIFIED-tier may anchor an act headline. secondary = DOCKETED may serve as texture/support, never solo-headline. texture_docket_input = FRESH-DRAFT: the derived template EXISTS (finding answered, L-9) but per T3-V2 a fresh-draft family may NOT headline — appears as texture or docket-input only.

Confidence.description: MEDIUM travels for: Age II rows 17-18 (Maxroll-only floor) + all 9 LE rows (1.0-era; Season-3 overhauls not reflected) + harvest-internal MEDIUM flags (Alkamos arc-sweep, Port Valbury sample access).

Disposition.description: R-b3 player-form coupling. hostile = the menu of future selves to fight through. kin = non-hostile + interactive (the family you became). Maps to emission factions.relationships[].type ('kin' keyed on player-form vs rival/hostile default).

ArchetypeForm.description: Era-personality-honest forms. BRAWL centralized-melee-convergence (Ages I/III native). OUTPOST/EMPLACEMENT decentralized faction-camp (Age II native). KIN traveling-kin encampment (exempt from era-nativity, T3-V4).

source_game.description: File-level source for Ages I-III (D2/PoE1/GD). For Age IV this is 'PoE2+LE' at deck-level; per-row source lives on each archetype's harvest_anchor (census §h.3 branch).

signature_family.description: The act-personality family (census reading 1). I=MELEE-STRIKE · II=DOT-AILMENT · III=CHANNELED-BEAM · IV=none (highest residual).

present_families.description: Families the era's HOSTILE deck may deal from (present-in-era per census §b; includes RDR-derived cells).

hole_families.description: Load-bearing holes: families ABSENT from this era's HOSTILE deck (Appendix-B, true genre history). MUST NOT deal hostiles from these. UNMAPPED rows must not force-map into a hole family (e.g. U-3/U-4 must not map into MELEE-STRIKE-II).

archetypes.description: ≥4 map-area archetypes (charter §4). All disposition=hostile (the kin archetype lives in kin_slot).

kin_slot.description: The ONE reserved traveling-kin encampment slot per act (T3-F5, T3-V4, T3-V5).

disposition.description: Deck archetypes are hostile; the era-exempt kin archetype is in EraDeck.kin_slot.

hostile_family_roster.description: Families this archetype may deal hostiles from. MUST be a subset of the deck's present_families (era-pure — T3-V4).

harvest_anchor.description: Harvest row refs grounding this archetype (e.g. 'I#14', 'IV#11 (PoE2)'). For Age IV includes the per-row PoE2/LE source tag.

biome_morph_slot.description: Q38 biome-morph rider (reserved v1): a biome re-skin hook. Consumption maps to floor_manifest.dominant_element.

era_nativity_exempt.description: T3-V4: the kin slot is the ONLY era-nativity exemption in the grammar. May present ANY family regardless of era-presence (whirlwind caravan in the trap-age).

family.description: Run-supplied from become-history (R-b3), not deck-fixed. NULL in the deck template; RD-1/run-time fills it from what the player became.

interaction_scope.description: T3-V5: v1 = encampment surface only (shop/boon hooks parameterized). Full kin-caravan NPC ensemble is DEFERRED to the story fold.

shop_hooks.description: Parameterized shop-interaction hook slots (v1 = slots, not filled dialogue).

boon_hooks.description: Parameterized boon-interaction hook slots (v1 = slots, not filled dialogue).

narrative_lineage.description: e.g. 'D2 Warriv/Meshif caravan'. Flavor lineage only; full ensemble deferred (T3-V5).

geometry.description: The spatial arrangement (converging spin-body, emplaced-anchor + mobile-screen, corridor arc-bounce, paired cross-fire, etc.).

pressure.description: The geometric pressure the arrangement creates on the player.

eras_present.description: Eras in which this formation is dealt. A formation may span eras (e.g. cb_lane_hold in II+III+IV).

harvest_anchor.description: Harvest row refs (GENRE-ATTESTED). Empty for RDR-derived formations.

derivation_source.description: For RDR-NATIVE-DERIVED formations: the kit-leader mechanism the formation derives from (e.g. 'D2 Druid Shapeshifting (player-kit)').

secondary.description: Census §b legend secondary co-mapping (legitimate formation-texture input, not a primary cell fill).

density_lean_note.description: f-6: for DOT-AILMENT-II, MESO variant-count may lean on kit-side mass (formations still trace to attested rows; kit-mass informs variant count only, not new content).

verbs.description: ≥1 pressure verb per family. R-b2 seed list: whirlwind spin-and-close · totem emplace-and-hold · trap pre-seed · beam channel-lanes · volley fan · DoT stack-and-retreat · melee swarm-the-brawl; rest derived from harvest pressure-pattern columns.

inherits_from.description: R-b2: the family kit-leader mechanism the verbs inherit from (e.g. 'WHIRLWIND kit-leader spin-and-close').

element_court_hook.description: Q38 coordinate hook where the verb carries an element/court (element-courts k=5). Speaks the kit side's vocabulary so fit() can compute.

cross_era_candidate.description: e.g. 'resurrection_leader' (U-2+U-6). CANDIDATE / NOT-A-FAMILY / docket-input — NOT canonized. See unmapped_reserved.

DerivedTemplate.$comment: The 5 RDR-NATIVE-DERIVED template entries (Gate-2 hard obligation L-9). Carried inside encounter_instances rosters and referenced by formation_catalogue. Provenance-flagged, tier-restricted per §5.0 two-law composition.

derivation_source.description: The player-kit mechanism the template derives from.

why_derived.description: The finding (f-1..f-4) + genre-history reason the cell has no monster-side attestation.

meso_formation_id.description: The RDR-derived formation this template uses (e.g. ss_derived_form_swap, ww_derived_frenzy_line).

validation_path.description: e.g. 'poe2db arc-chain direct pass' for CHAIN-BOUNCE-IV — the route to upgrade RDR-derived → GENRE-ATTESTED in a future lap.

disposition_in_spec.description: How the spec holds it (reserved; texture-secondary on <formation>; candidate cross-era verb).

must_not_map_into.description: Load-bearing constraint: e.g. U-3/U-4 MUST NOT map into MELEE-STRIKE-II (the PoE1 melee hole).

candidate_verb.description: e.g. 'resurrection_leader' for U-2+U-6. CANDIDATE / NOT-A-FAMILY / docket-input. NOT canonized.

parked_ruling_needed.description: The future-docket ruling that would resolve this UNMAPPED.

EncounterInstance.$comment: OPTIONAL at W1 (schema-ready, empty valid). RD-1 populates: an act-structured encounter with a tier-restricted roster + formation + verb-set. Forward-instantiability target (charter §4, §6.4).

act_ordinal.description: OPTIONAL positioning hint ONLY (act-order agnosticism, §1.3). Decks compose under chronological/reverse/player-chosen order; never a structural dependency.

archetype_id.description: The MACRO archetype this instance realizes (e.g. I-D), or the kin_slot id.

roster.description: The pack. Each entry ties a monster (emission monsters[].id ref) to a family, tier, provenance, and serving_role. Kin rosters carry disposition kin.

formation_id.description: The MESO formation the roster stands in (formation_catalogue ref).

verb_set_families.description: The families whose MICRO verb-sets this instance exerts (pressure_verbs refs).

cluster_id_ref.description: Optional bind to emission factions.clusters[].cluster_id (R-b1 family=faction join).

floor_id_ref.description: Optional bind to emission floor_manifest.floor_sequence[].floor_id (MACRO substrate join).

monster_id_ref.description: Bind to emission monsters[].id. MICRO/MESO bind via monsters[] fields preferred_behavior/skill_rotation_priority/aggro_radius_m/leash_distance_m/skills[].

serving_role.description: The T3-V2 × L-9 restriction as data. RD-1/consumer reads this: a texture_docket_input entry may NEVER be the encounter's headline hostile; only headline_capable may anchor an act.

is_derived_template.description: true for the 5 RDR-NATIVE-DERIVED templates (§5). See DerivedTemplate for their full spec.

derivation_source.description: Present iff provenance=RDR-NATIVE-DERIVED: the kit-leader mechanism derived from.
